messages:
Priya: Quick FYI — spotted a tiny issue in the Runtime Guide under 'Embedding best practices' — the inline curl snippet links to a gist that 404s. Anyone owns that page?
Alex: Thanks for the catch. Can you paste the link?
Priya: https://internal.kb/runbook/embedding-best-practices#curl-example
Sam: I can take this. If it's just a missing gist we usually rehost to snippets.redwood.
Alex: Sounds good. If it’s a gist we rehost + update the snippet to use the current API path. Sam, can you handle both?
Sam: Yep. Quick note — the snippet uses `v1beta` in the URL. Should be `v1`. Not urgent but good to fix while we're here.
Priya: Good catch on the version. Won't break anything but prefer consistent examples.
docs-bot: link-checker: New failure detected at 2026-03-22T14:02:00Z — /runbook/embedding-best-practices — curl-snippet-123.gist.github.com => 404
Evan: Thanks team. Sam — if you open a PR, ping me and I'll fast-approve so it lands in the docs sprint. Trying to keep the sprint small this week.
Sam: Created PR 6299990001 — replaced gist with internal snippet, updated API path to `v1`, added a one-line changelog. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/6299990001
Sam: Also ran the local snippet linter, got one trailing-whitespace failure, fixing now.
Alex: Can we add @docs-team to the PR for visibility and CI watch?
Priya: Done — added @docs-team in the PR description and left a comment about the curl version.
Sam: Lint fixed, CI rerun.
docs-bot: CI: docs-staging build passed for PR 6299990001.
Sam: Merged to staging — snippet now served from snippets.redwood.
Sam: Quick test on staging: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{...}'` renders fine.
Evan: Nice. Schedule prod deploy during docs-merge window tomorrow 02:00 UTC?
Sam: Yep, I'll include the PR in the prod bundle.
docs-bot: Deploy scheduled: production deploy for docs at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z.
Evan: Great. Marking this resolved from my side.
Priya: Resolved, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
